food.excerpt: Mumbai's street food culture propelled it into the top five of TasteAtlas's 2025-26 ranking of the world's best food cities, while Amritsar, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and Chennai also earned spots on the 100-city list.
food.nri_angle: The TasteAtlas ranking validates the culinary traditions diaspora communities carry with them, from Mumbai's vada pav to Chennai's filter coffee.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Glasgow's Mister Singh's Hosted Team India, Then a Map on Its Napkins Sparked Outrage
food.excerpt: Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain called out the iconic Punjabi restaurant after its printed napkins displayed an India map missing the entire Northeast region.
food.nri_angle: The controversy highlights how diaspora-run restaurants abroad represent India's identity — and the emotional weight of accurate territorial depiction for overseas communities.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: A Japanese Chef Spent 15 Years Perfecting Biryani. Tokyo's Michelin Guide Noticed.
food.excerpt: Chef Takamasa Osawa's 10-seat biryani restaurant in Tokyo earned a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Tokyo 2026, making it only the second biryani-focused establishment globally to receive Michelin recognition.
food.nri_angle: The Michelin recognition of a biryani restaurant in Tokyo highlights both the global spread of Indian cuisine and the absence of Michelin coverage from India's own culinary heartlands.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Flipkart Enters Food Delivery With Low Commissions, Targeting Zomato-Swiggy Duopoly
food.excerpt: Walmart-backed Flipkart plans a Bengaluru pilot with restaurant commissions as low as 10%, far below the 25-35% charged by incumbents, as India's $9 billion food delivery market heats up.
food.nri_angle: Flipkart's low-commission entry could reshape food delivery pricing across India, affecting how diaspora families order food back home and signaling cheaper delivery for everyone.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Lion Brewery Co Returns to India After Six Decades With Premium Beer Launch
food.excerpt: The 1836-founded London brewery that helped pioneer India Pale Ale is entering Delhi's premium beer market with Copperdrop Spirits as its distribution partner.
food.nri_angle: Indians in Singapore and the UK, where Lion Brewery Co already operates, will recognise the brand now arriving on home soil, completing an IPA homecoming with cultural resonance.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Beetroot Cutlet Recipe: How To Make Crispy Tikki at Home
food.excerpt: This vibrant beetroot tikki combines grated beets, mashed potato, and Indian spices into a crispy, protein-rich snack that works as an evening nibble, party starter, or even a burger patty.
food.nri_angle: Beetroot cutlets are a simple way for diaspora cooks to recreate a beloved Indian street snack with ingredients available at any grocery store abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Rajasthan Challenges Gujarat's GI Tag on Cumin and Fennel
food.excerpt: Farmers and scientists in Rajasthan are demanding revocation of Geographical Indication tags awarded to Unjha cumin and fennel, arguing Gujarat's largest spice market is a trading hub, not a production region.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora consumers who prize authentic Indian spices, the dispute raises questions about the true origin of cumin and fennel marketed under the Unjha label in international markets.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Garam Masala to Za'atar: The Ancient Spice Blends Modern Science Is Finally Validating
food.excerpt: Centuries-old spice blends from India, Morocco, Ethiopia, and Japan are drawing clinical attention as researchers document their anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and gut-health benefits in a booming $4.75 billion global market.
food.nri_angle: Indian diaspora's traditional spice knowledge is being validated by modern science while driving commercial demand in global markets
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Moringa Goes Mainstream: How India's Humble Drumstick Tree Conquered the Global Superfood Market
food.excerpt: The global moringa products market is projected to reach $15–25 billion by the mid-2030s, driven by demand for plant-based supplements and functional foods — with India supplying over 60% of the world's production.
food.nri_angle: Indian diaspora consumers find a familiar kitchen staple rebranded as a premium Western superfood, while diaspora entrepreneurs bridge Indian supply chains with branded consumer markets abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Makhana Kheer: A Creamy, Nutritious Dessert for Sawan Fasting Season
food.excerpt: This simple fox nut kheer combines roasted makhana, full-fat milk, and saffron into a satisfying vrat-friendly treat rich in protein and fiber.
food.nri_angle: Makhana is increasingly available at Indian grocery stores worldwide, making this a practical fasting recipe for diaspora families observing Sawan abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Karnataka Restaurants Escalate Revolt Against Swiggy and Zomato With August 15 Ultimatum
food.excerpt: Hotel and restaurant associations across Karnataka, from Bengaluru to tier-2 cities like Belagavi, are threatening a mass delisting from food delivery platforms over unauthorized deductions and crushing commissions.
food.nri_angle: The outcome could reshape operations for small family-run restaurants across Karnataka that serve as cultural touchstones for NRIs visiting their hometowns.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Maharashtra Completes ₹1,601 Crore Acquisition of Iconic Air India Building in Mumbai
travel.excerpt: The 23-storey Nariman Point landmark, once the airline's headquarters, will be converted into a consolidated government office complex to house scattered state departments.
travel.nri_angle: The Air India building is an iconic symbol for the Indian diaspora — the national carrier's former headquarters that connected India to the world is now transitioning to a new chapter as a state government complex.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Oman Launches Free 14-Day Tourist Visa for 103 Countries — Here's What Indian Travelers Need to Know
travel.excerpt: The sultanate's amended residence regulations open visa-free entry for over a hundred nationalities, but Indian passport holders must meet specific conditions to qualify for the two-week stay.
travel.nri_angle: For the 7.4 million Indians living in GCC countries, Oman's visa-free entry removes a key barrier for weekend getaways, while Indians with US/UK/Schengen visas gain hassle-free access.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: WestJet Flight Attendants Issue Strike Notice, Threatening Peak Summer Travel
travel.excerpt: Canada's second-largest airline faces a potential walkout starting August 2 after cabin crew issued a 72-hour strike notice over a dispute about unpaid work, with 75,000 passengers at risk.
travel.nri_angle: With over 1.8 million people of Indian origin in Canada, the potential WestJet disruption during peak summer travel could affect diaspora travelers and their connecting itineraries.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Indian Passport Now Offers Visa-Free or Visa-on-Arrival Access to 74 Countries
travel.excerpt: India's Ministry of External Affairs lists 27 visa-free and 47 visa-on-arrival destinations for Indian citizens in 2026, with Malaysia, Thailand, and Kazakhstan among the notable entries.
travel.nri_angle: Indians abroad with U.S., UK, or Schengen visas gain additional visa-free access to countries like Argentina, South Korea, and Mexico, creating new leisure and business travel options.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo Signs MoU With Ministry of Tourism to Promote Incredible India
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline partners with the government's flagship tourism initiative as the ministry accelerates corporate tie-ups with airlines, tech companies, and content platforms to modernise the Incredible India brand.
travel.image_caption: IndiGo, India's largest airline, has signed an MoU with the Ministry of Tourism to promote the Incredible India campaign across its network of over 400 aircraft.
travel.nri_angle: IndiGo's expanding international network and codeshare partnerships create new touchpoints for NRIs and PIOs to discover India's tourism offerings on routes they already fly.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Five Structural Barriers That Keep Foreign Tourists Away From India
travel.excerpt: Despite world-class cultural heritage, India captures just 1.4% of global tourist arrivals — held back by visa friction, steep taxes, scam risks, regulatory red tape, and overtourism at flagship destinations.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who host visiting friends and family in India regularly encounter these barriers firsthand, from visa headaches to tourist scams and overtourism at popular destinations.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo to Discontinue All Widebody Operations, End Norse Atlantic Lease
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline will switch Mumbai-Amsterdam to A321XLR and suspend London Heathrow service until its own Airbus A350s arrive, citing geopolitical disruptions.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers in the US and UK face disruptions as IndiGo's ambitious long-haul expansion hits turbulence, with London Heathrow service suspended indefinitely and route changes affecting diaspora travel plans.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Danube Hits Record Lows, Stranding Cruise Ships and Threatening Energy Across Central Europe
travel.excerpt: Europe's second-longest river has dropped to unprecedented levels in Hungary, Serbia, and Romania, forcing cruise cancellations, grounding a Viking ship, and pushing Hungary toward a nuclear plant shutdown.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers planning European river cruises this summer face widespread itinerary disruptions and cancellations on the Danube and Rhine.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Cordelia Cruises Eyes Mangaluru as Next Port of Call in Fleet Expansion Push
travel.excerpt: Waterways Leisure Tourism, India's only listed domestic cruise operator, is evaluating New Mangalore Port for future cruise services as it prepares to nearly triple fleet capacity by 2028.
travel.image_caption: New Mangalore Port, which Cordelia Cruises is eyeing as its next port of call for Indian coastal routes.
travel.nri_angle: Cordelia's Indian-centric cruise experience and potential Mangaluru embarkation point offer NRI travellers, especially those with ties to coastal Karnataka, a new way to explore India by sea.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: US Makes Visa Bond Program Permanent, Raises Maximum to $20,000 — India Not on List
carousel.excerpt: The State Department's final rule takes effect today, requiring applicants from 50 countries to post refundable bonds of up to $20,000 for B1/B2 visas. India remains excluded from the program.
carousel.nri_angle: India is excluded from the visa bond list, providing relief for Indian travelers, but neighboring Bangladesh, Nepal, and Bhutan are affected, impacting the broader South Asian community.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Delhi Court Acquits Former WFI Chief Brij Bhushan Singh in Wrestlers' Sexual Harassment Case
carousel.excerpt: The verdict ends a three-year legal battle sparked by allegations from six female wrestlers, though the complainants have vowed to appeal.
carousel.image_caption: Olympic wrestler Vinesh Phogat said the complainants will appeal the Delhi court's acquittal of former WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh.
carousel.nri_angle: The case has been a touchstone for diaspora communities tracking gender-based violence, institutional reform, and accountability for powerful figures in Indian sport and politics.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: August TV Is Stacked: The Shards, Ted Lasso, Lanterns and More Hit Screens
carousel.excerpt: From Ryan Murphy's serial-killer thriller to the DC Universe's prestige debut featuring Poorna Jagannathan, August 2026 brings an unusually loaded slate of premieres across every major streamer.
carousel.nri_angle: Poorna Jagannathan, the Indian-origin Never Have I Ever star, plays a key recurring role in HBO's Lanterns, one of the month's biggest premieres, marking growing South Asian visibility in superhero tentpoles.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Kashmir's Owais Yaqoob Stuns Unbeaten Delyan Georgiev With First-Round TKO in Bulgaria
carousel.excerpt: The 24-year-old Khabib Nurmagomedov protégé from Pulwama extended his winning streak to six fights, stopping the Bulgarian hometown favorite at Brave CF 107 in Burgas.
carousel.nri_angle: Yaqoob's rise highlights India's growing presence in global MMA and inspires young Indian diaspora athletes exploring combat sports beyond cricket and football.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Xbox's Disc-to-Digital Program Nears Launch as Gaming Goes All-Digital
carousel.excerpt: Microsoft's Positron feature will let players convert physical Xbox discs into digital licenses, as both console giants prepare for a future without optical media.
carousel.nri_angle: The all-digital gaming shift affects Indian gamers who rely on physical disc markets and second-hand exchanges, while raising questions about bandwidth and regional pricing.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Global AI Trade Unwind Drives Foreign Investors Back to Indian Equities
carousel.excerpt: After selling $29 billion in the first half of 2026, foreign investors turned net buyers of Indian stocks in July as a pullback in AI-linked markets triggered a major rotation into India's diversified benchmarks.
carousel.nri_angle: NRI investors with portfolios spanning U.S. tech and Indian equities face rebalancing decisions as the AI-to-India rotation reshapes global flows.
